close.title: How would you like to close Lucent?
close.body: Your music and lyric sync will keep running unless you choose to quit completely.
help.title: First time using Lucent
help.step1: Open NetEase Cloud Music and keep its lyrics page visible.
help.step2: Lucent mirrors the currently highlighted line in the desktop capsule.
help.step3: Use Appearance to adjust glass, lyrics, progress bar, and artwork.
help.step4: Use Room to host or join when you want to listen together.
onboarding.welcome.title: Put lyrics on your desktop.
onboarding.welcome.body: Open NetEase Cloud Music and keep the lyrics page visible. Lucent prioritizes its highlighted line.
onboarding.reopen.title: Come back here whenever you need.
onboarding.reopen.body: Right-click the desktop capsule to open the console. If click-through is enabled, press Ctrl + Alt + L first. You can also use the tray icon or Ctrl + Alt + S.
onboarding.next.title: Play first, then tune the appearance.
onboarding.next.body: Use Play to confirm the source, Appearance to preview the capsule, and Room when you want to sync with friends.
settings.description: These options affect only the Lucent console, not lyric sync or the desktop capsule appearance.
settings.petMotion.reducedHint: Windows animations are disabled, so the pet uses Gentle mode automatically. Choose Full to let it walk around.
look.preview.play.hint: Controls only the preview above and does not affect lyric playback
look.hints.show.hint: Adds a plain-language explanation below each item
look.quick.title: Quick presets
look.quick.completeTip: The good preset applies a complete appearance, including glass values, without leaving values from another preset behind.
look.random.hint: Changes only visual colors, glass, and effects; sync and window settings stay unchanged
look.profiles.title: My profiles
look.profiles.placeholder: Profile name, for example: Everyday / Projector
look.style.title: Style
look.vinyl.show.hint: Shows a rotating record on the left of the capsule
look.songName.show.hint: Uses a separate small line without changing the lyric layout
look.edgeSmooth.hint: Reduces pixelation around the capsule edge
look.bilingual.hint: Original and translation when the track provides both
look.layout.title: 🧭 Lyric layout
look.layout.hint: Changes only text scale, spacing, and alignment; lyric sync is unaffected.
look.typography.title: 🔤 Fonts and text tuning
look.fontWeight.lyric.hint: Heavier text is easier to read on a busy background
look.letterSpacing.lyric.hint: Wider spacing is easier to read but makes the line longer
look.letterSpacing.translation.hint: Character spacing for the translation line
look.lineHeight.lyric.hint: Vertical line spacing; this affects capsule height
look.translationScale.hint: Translation size relative to the original; 100% is equal
look.readability.title: 📝 Lyric size and readability
look.maxWidth.hint: Lyrics wrap after this width; narrow values may create two lines
look.outline.hint: Adds a dark edge for bright or busy wallpapers
look.lyricAlpha.hint: Text opacity; lower values are subtler
look.clarity.hint: Higher values sharpen text; lower values retain a soft glow
look.translationGap.hint: Space between the two lyric lines
look.progressGap.hint: Space between lyrics and the progress bar
look.clarity.tip: Adjusts only sharpness, outline, and shadow; it never creates a text background.
look.songNameAlpha.hint: Opacity of the small song and artist line
room.create.sub: You play; everyone else follows your lyrics
room.join.sub: Ask the host for the address and paste it here
room.name: Room name
room.code: Room code (optional, acts as a password)
room.noAddress: No local network address found — check your connection
room.whichNetwork.hint: Your computer has more than one network. Friends on the same LAN should use Ethernet or Wi-Fi; friends connecting over a VPN should use the VPN.
settings.title: Settings
settings.language.hint: Changes apply immediately and are remembered.
settings.showHints.hint: Adds a plain-language line under each item
